purpose: Identify completed abandonment-to-recolonization cycles in identity-resolved, mutually exclusive SMP breeding SiteIDs using only explicit zero/positive count states, before any abundance magnitude is opened.

vacancy_spell.abandonment: occupied in complete calendar year t and explicit zero in t+1
vacancy_spell.recolonization: after one or more consecutive explicit-zero complete years, first later complete calendar year with count > 0
vacancy_spell.completeness: every retained SiteID must be observed in every year used by the spell under the frozen panel roster
vacancy_spell.no_gap_rule: every year from abandonment transition through recolonization transition must be calendar-consecutive and complete; do not bridge an unobserved year
vacancy_spell.multiple_spells: allowed; all qualifying completed spells retained
vacancy_spell.first_colonization: not part of the primary test because no within-site abandonment threshold exists to pair against it
vacancy_spell.transition_gap_years: recolonize_from - abandon_from; because both transitions are consecutive-year transitions, this equals the separation between their transition midpoints.

allowed_outputs_before_magnitudes: number of completed spells by site/panel/species
number/list of eligible pseudo start years for the trajectory-drift null

identifiability_gate.requirement: All prior conditions must pass after restricting to spells with >=3 same-panel elapsed-time-matched pseudo placements.

decision.if_passed: Freeze the exact identity-resolved completed-spell roster and authorize one magnitude-opening hysteresis execution.
decision.if_failed: Stop the hysteresis route. Do not lower cycle-count, species, SiteID, MasterSite, identity, or gap thresholds.

identity_requirement: Input roster must be the output of the frozen SiteID identity gate; unresolved, merged, split, overlapping, boundary-changed, retired or replaced SiteIDs are ineligible.

trajectory_drift_null_support.purpose: Before count magnitudes open, enumerate all pseudo placements of each completed spell on the same panel year grid that preserve the exact transition-gap years.
trajectory_drift_null_support.pseudo_start_rule: A pseudo start year s is eligible only if s, s+1, s+d, and s+d+1 are all frozen complete years, where d is the observed transition_gap_years.
trajectory_drift_null_support.use: Only spells with at least 3 eligible pseudo placements enter the magnitude-opening gate.
trajectory_drift_null_support.magnitude_blinding: Pseudo placements use year identities only; no abundance magnitude enters this support filter.
